handoff.salientSummary: Implemented GET /api/v1/evaluations endpoint with full pagination support (page, limit, total, pages). Default page=1, limit=10. Invalid parameters return 400. Empty list and page beyond range handled correctly. All unit tests pass (8 test cases) and manual curl verification confirms correct behavior.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: Created ListEvaluations handler in internal/handler/evaluation_handler.go with full pagination support: query parameter parsing (page, limit), defaults (page=1, limit=10), validation (400 for invalid values), repository call with pagination, total count and pages calculation (ceil division), model/dataset name resolution for each evaluation item, and response construction with tasks array. Registered route in cmd/api/main.go. Added comprehensive unit tests covering all scenarios.
